items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: I thought Rudy Vallée. I was just curious

ctx.x: They had this guy playing alto playing Josephine and what was his name? I can't forget his name right there but he was playing that tune I thought Rudy Vallée. I was just curious

were these real tight arrangements because later these guys just sort of jammed they played tunes like Careless Love and they just seemed to kind of you know play them pretty loosely but in those days was it much more heavily arranged? Was the music much tighter?
